operators.name: einsum_bhwc_to_bwh

parameters.name: input
parameters.layout: strided (supports non-contiguous input, expected contiguous or strided as per reference; implementation must honor strides)

semantics: For each batch b, width w, height h: output[b,w,h] = input[b,h,w,:] summed over channel dimension (channels=3).
Preserves data type float32. Output is contiguous with shape [batch, width, height].
Input may be non-contiguous; implementation must account for strides.

operators.name: abs_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.layout: strided (supports non-contiguous input, expected contiguous after einsum)

semantics: Element-wise absolute value, preserving shape and storage layout as produced by previous op.
Output is a new tensor containing absolute values of input elements.
Applies einsum with equation 'bhwc->bwh' to input of shape [256,128,1024,3].
Output is new tensor with shape [256,1024,128], dtype float32.
Essentially a reduction over channel dimension after implicit transpose.
Element-wise absolute value on the previous tensor.
Output shape remains [256,1024,128], same dtype and device.
Returns the final tensor after abs operation.
